alt: Abstract macro of swirling light blue and white liquid paint lines against a black background
title: Blue Fluid Trails
description: Close-up of fluid acrylic pour art: thin cyan and white trails curve across a dark field, with tiny white specks that read like glitter or distant stars.

alt: Aerial view of the Chicago skyline beside Lake Michigan under a pink and purple sunset sky
title: Chicago Skyline at Sunset
description: High-angle photograph of downtown Chicago at golden hour, with the Willis Tower and neighboring skyscrapers catching warm light against Lake Michigan.

alt: Tropical beach at sunset with a gentle wave on white sand and turquoise water under a soft orange sky
title: Tropical Beach at Golden Hour
description: A quiet shoreline where wet sand meets calm turquoise water. The sun sits low on the horizon beside a dark silhouette of palms.

alt: Macro close-up of a cluster of glowing pink, orange, blue, and green miniature light bulbs
title: Colorful Fairy Lights
description: A dense bundle of miniature holiday bulbs photographed up close. Shallow depth of field turns the surrounding lights into colorful bokeh.

alt: Abstract fluid painting with swirls of red, pink, and white paint and gold glitter
title: Crimson Fluid Abstract
description: Acrylic-pour marbling in deep reds and pinks, streaked with white and flecks of metallic gold.

alt: Side view of an adult male lion with a full mane walking through green grass past a tree
title: Male Lion Walking
description: A tawny male lion captured mid-stride in a grassy enclosure, its dark mane catching the daylight.

alt: Seated audience in a darkened conference hall looking toward a presentation
title: Conference Audience
description: Rows of people sit in a dim indoor venue, facing off-camera toward a stage. A grid of out-of-focus lights fills the wall above them.

alt: Snow-dusted mountain peaks rising above a thick sea of clouds at sunrise
title: Alpine Peaks Above Clouds
description: Jagged alpine summits pierce a valley filled with inversion cloud, photographed from a high ridge under an orange and lavender sky in Randa, Switzerland.

alt: Woman in a camouflage jacket holding a Canon DSLR to her eye against a blurred city night backdrop
title: Night Photographer
description: A photographer shoots during blue hour. City windows and streetlights fall out of focus behind her, leaving warm bokeh against cool urban blues.
